jobs.name: 04-repair
jobs.prompt: Edit only the flight pose in the attached Auralis pixel character. Keep exact head, facial identity, burgundy headphones, hair, jacket, shirt, body proportions, near ARM bent FORWARD in front of chest and far arm BACK. Correct legs: nearer/lighter thigh must travel BACK, overlapping far thigh at hip; farther/darker leg extends moderately FORWARD. Make rear heel raised with knee flexed and front ankle relaxed; front cream sneaker is nearly horizontal with toe slightly DOWN, never sharply pointed up. Shorten extended stride by about twenty percent to make an easy jog, not leap. Keep hip height and leg segment lengths credible. Both feet off ground for low flight. Clear near/far layering with slightly darker far leg, without changing clothing colors globally. One full-body right-facing pose, exact same crisp pixel style and palette. Genuine transparent background, no glow, shadows, floor, labels or other objects. Preserve all identity features and upper body as closely as possible.

Single complete right-facing full body centered with margins, genuine transparency, no floor, shadow, glow, blur, labels or other objects.
